10.constraint: Use this khaki textured half-button sweatshirt once only for Premium Spring/Fall/Winter Casual Everyday, Weekend, Travel, Campus, creative work or a relaxed daytime Date. Pair its controlled relaxed shape with a clean straight or gently tapered bottom in ecru, cream, charcoal, muted olive, burgundy or controlled dark denim and low-profile cream, tan, brown or gray footwear; never add a baggy or puddled bottom, oversized outer layer, muddy head-to-toe khaki palette, bulky trainer or any Wedding/Wedding Guest use.

rejectionGroups.reason: These product-only or hanger-only basics, hoodies, shirts and tank provide no credible adult fit, movement or hem-length proof and are too generic, dark or repetitive to approve.
The floral washed graphic tee and pearl-star plaid zip shirt are novelty-led and visibly decorated rather than clean versatile menswear.
Both colors of the collarless shirt are overlong with a drooping tunic-like body and fail the controlled proportion gate.
The fully transparent open-mesh top is costume or nightlife styling rather than a useful modern wardrobe garment.
The dark washed gradient hoodie is oversized, visually muddy and redundant beside stronger controlled hoodies already approved.
The mustard and pink colors are useful, but both keep visible ENTHUSIASTIC BRIGHT slogan branding on the lower pocket and therefore fail the clean-product gate.
The dark small-check plaid shirt is visually repetitive, long and muddy and adds no stronger role than cleaner accepted overshirts.
Every bottom is cargo-led, pocket-heavy, drawstring-heavy, excessively wide, cuff-bunched, logoed or visibly puddled and recreates the baggy-bottom problem.
These faux-leather moto jackets are shiny, skinny, seam-heavy or graphic and read as dated low-cost outerwear.
These are groom, wedding, host-performance or rhinestone tuxedo sets with skinny, theatrical or embellished tailoring; Wedding and Wedding Guest remain excluded and untouched.
The oversized denim jacket is heavily distressed, patched and slogan-labeled and reads as novelty streetwear rather than a clean modern layer.
These hooded, racing and bomber jackets are dominated by busy graphics, slogans, patches or synthetic technical styling rather than clean Zara-led outerwear.

qaSummary: 40 identities and all 133 recorded color images rendered; 133 displayed images loaded with zero broken files.
2 accepted with one exact color and variant selected each: a khaki textured half-button sweatshirt and a warm coffee textured button-up overshirt.
38 rejected after the base pass and close inspection of all six variants across three credible top identities; every bottom and outerwear product failed.
Both selected identities, source products, variants and images have zero collision with every prior accepted or conditional item.

Rejections include unproven basics, novelty and transparent tops, slogan overshirts, repetitive plaid, twelve cargo-heavy or puddled bottoms, faux-leather and graphic jackets, distressed denim and wedding or rhinestone tuxedos.
